cards.signin: {{cast.user}} signs in to {{cast.company}}'s portal through the portal's own form; the password goes only to PingOne.
cards.pkce: A stolen authorization code cannot be redeemed without the verifier {{cast.agent}} never sent.
cards.par: {{cast.agent}}'s request is pushed to PingOne up front and referred to by a one-time handle.
cards.jar: {{cast.agent}}'s request travels as a signed object, so a changed scope would break the signature.
cards.clientCredentials: At {{cast.company}}, the {{cast.serviceWord}} authenticates as itself to fetch reference data, with no patient involved.
cards.lifecycle: {{cast.agent}}'s access to {{cast.user}}'s records is renewed, checked, then cut off when {{cast.company}} revokes it.
cards.userinfo: The portal confirms who {{cast.user}} is by asking PingOne with {{cast.user}}'s token.
cards.device: {{cast.user}} signs in on the waiting-room kiosk by entering a code on a phone.
cards.ciba: {{cast.agent}} wants {{cast.user}}'s consent before sharing a result; the request lands on {{cast.user}}'s phone, not in the agent's window.
cards.tokenExchange: A request from {{cast.user}} passes through {{cast.agent}}, and the exchanged token records it.
cards.piflow: The portal drives PingOne's sign-in through an API and shows its own screens.
